description: Per-class numerators with Wilson intervals and the discarded-as-unknown share, Kaplan-Meier survival of directive adoption by cohort, directive lineage, declaration growth, and RFC 9728 auth-discovery conformance detail — none of it on the free surface — with an ed25519 attestation naming the chain head it was derived from. FREE SAMPLE, no credential: https://atlas.geosensor.tech/free/sample (names every section and shows two numerator cells in full). Price $0.02 or €0.02 via x402 v2, payable in USDC or EURC (scheme `exact`, network `eip155:84532`) — the `accepts` array carries both and the client chooses; EURC is a euro e-money token, so a euro payment reaches an EU bank with no FX step. needs a bearer credential AND a payment that is VERIFIED and then SETTLED before anything is returned. TESTNET only (Base Sepolia): settlement is on-chain but moves test USDC with no monetary value. OR SUBSCRIBE: €19/month for 2,000 calls. AN AGENT CAN BUY ONE ITSELF at https://atlas.geosensor.tech/paid/subscribe — x402 v2, 19000000 atomic units of USDC or EURC, and the response returns the key in its body and in the x-subscription-key header. Present that key in the x-subscription-key header afterwards and no per-call payment is needed. A human can be invoiced in euros instead, with no crypto at all. PAYING COSTS YOU NOTHING: this is a TEST network, the tokens are free from https://faucet.circle.com (Base Sepolia), and you need no ETH because the facilitator pays the gas. No third party has completed a payment yet; doing so is how you tell us this is worth having.
